resources.string: Make two quick chopping motions (like swinging a hammer twice) to turn the flashlight on or off. Works from the lock screen too.
Raise it if chops aren\'t detected. Lower it if the light turns on by itself while walking.
Keeps the processor awake so chops are heard while the phone is locked. Uses a bit more battery.
Recommended: stops Android from killing the listener to save battery.
Chop twice to toggle the flashlight
